title: Differentials of the universal first order thickening restrict to the differentials of the base
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For a formally unramified morphism h : Z -> X over S with universal first order thickening Z in Z', the lemma proves that the canonical map (h')^*Omega_{X/S} -> Omega_{Z'/S} becomes an isomorphism after restricting along Z. The proof computes the conormal sheaf of Z in Z' through the transitivity sequence and compares it with the differentials of the thickening, showing that the term contributing to the difference vanishes because h is formally unramified. The comparison of the two conormal and differential terms is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 1332-1342 statement, proof 1344-1357.
